# Constraints Intel

**Generated by:** gsd-doc-synthesizer (MERGE mode)
**Ingest date:** 2026-06-30
**Source classifications:** .planning/intel/classifications/ (33 docs)

Two layers of constraints:
1. **As-built v1.0 baseline** — mined from the 8 DOC-type functional specs. These constrain
   the KG implementation (Phase 1 onward).
2. **PRD-derived domain constraints** — SPEC-grade material (graph data models, edge-weight
   formulas, connector catalogs, interchange standards) embedded in the 25 ambiti-estensione
   PRDs. These supply concrete success criteria for the granular per-vertical phases.

All 25 PRDs converge on the SAME persistence and AI constraints (see "Universal KG
constraints" below) — none introduce Neo4j or a dedicated graph DB, so they are CONSISTENT
with the locked datastore decision (no conflict).

---

## As-built v1.0 baseline (from DOC functional specs)

## Constraints: LLM Gateway

title: LLM retry policy (as-built)
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/01-llm-gateway.md
type: nfr
content:
  Max retry attempts: 3 (configurable via localmind.llm.retry.max-attempts)
  Backoff base: 1000ms (configurable via localmind.llm.retry.backoff-ms)
  Backoff schedule: attempt 1 = 1000ms, attempt 2 = 2000ms, attempt 3 = 4000ms (exponential)
  Retryable errors: HTTP 408 (timeout), HTTP 429 (rate limit), HTTP 500 (server error), HTTP 503 (service unavailable), network errors
  Non-retryable errors: HTTP 400, 401, 403
  Impact on KG: GraphRAG LLM calls go through LlmGatewayService and inherit this policy; no separate retry layer needed in GraphRagService

title: LLM provider timeout values (as-built)
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/01-llm-gateway.md
type: nfr
content:
  Ollama: 120s (local models may be slow on commodity hardware)
  OpenAI: 60s
  Anthropic: 60s
  Google: 60s
  Impact on KG: GraphRagContextBuilder token-budget pruning must complete within these windows; entity extraction batch job is not subject to these timeouts (uses separate Spring Batch step)

title: Fallback chain order (as-built)
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/01-llm-gateway.md
type: protocol
content:
  Default: OLLAMA -> OPENAI -> ANTHROPIC -> GOOGLE
  Note: Current codebase includes DeepSeek/Mistral/XAI (added post-spec); confirmed in PROJECT.md Validated
  Configurable via: localmind.llm.fallback.order
  Impact on KG: GraphRAG private-node guard must apply to ALL cloud providers in the chain, not just OpenAI (PRIV-02)

title: LlmClient interface contract (as-built)
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/01-llm-gateway.md
type: api-contract
content:
  interface LlmClient {
    ChatResponse generate(ChatRequest request);
    LlmProvider getProvider();
    boolean isAvailable();
  }
  ChatRequest fields: message (required), provider (optional), model (optional), temperature (0.0-2.0, default 0.7), maxTokens (default 2048), systemPrompt (optional), conversationId (optional UUID)
  ChatResponse fields: content, provider, model, promptTokens, completionTokens, totalTokens, latencyMs, estimatedCost, fallbackUsed
  Impact on KG: GraphRagLlmAdapter wraps LlmClient; ChatRequest.systemPrompt carries GraphRAG context; ChatRequest.maxTokens must be coordinated with GraphRagContextBuilder budget

title: LLM error exhaustion response (as-built)
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/01-llm-gateway.md
type: protocol
content:
  When all providers in fallback chain are unavailable: HTTP 503 with descriptive message listing tried providers and errors
  Impact on KG: GraphRagService must handle 503 from LlmGatewayService gracefully without corrupting graph state or weight updates

## Constraints: Document Intelligence / RAG Pipeline

title: Qdrant collection boundary (as-built)
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/02-document-intelligence-rag.md
type: schema
content:
  Existing document chunk collection: localmind_documents
  Collection must NOT be shared with graph node embeddings
  New graph node collection MUST be: localmind_graph_nodes (confirmed by research/SUMMARY.md)
  Protocol: gRPC port 6334 (primary), HTTP port 6333 (fallback)
  Impact on KG: Phase 3 (Graph Semantic Layer) — GraphSemanticAdapter creates localmind_graph_nodes as a new collection; mixing with localmind_documents corrupts GraphRAG anchor selection (research flag confirmed)

title: Document chunking parameters (as-built defaults)
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/02-document-intelligence-rag.md
type: schema
content:
  chunk-size: 500 characters (configurable)
  chunk-overlap: 50 characters (configurable)
  Strategy: character-based with overlap, sentence-boundary aware
  Metadata per chunk: documentId, chunkIndex, startOffset, endOffset
  Impact on KG: Document chunks are NOT graph nodes; they are Qdrant payload in localmind_documents. INGEST-01 creates ONE KnowledgeEntity per document (not per chunk). Knowledge Graph node embeddings use document-level or section-level granularity, not chunk-level.

title: Document similarity search defaults (as-built)
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/02-document-intelligence-rag.md
type: nfr
content:
  default-top-k: 5
  similarity-threshold: 0.7 (cosine similarity)
  Impact on KG: Phase 3 semantic search on localmind_graph_nodes may use different top-k and threshold; do not inherit document search defaults without explicit decision

title: Document upload constraints (as-built)
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/02-document-intelligence-rag.md
type: schema
content:
  max-file-size: 50 MB (52428800 bytes)
  Upload endpoint: POST /api/v1/documents/upload (multipart)
  Returns: 202 Accepted (async processing)
  Validation: 400 on unsupported format, 413 on size exceeded, skip (log) on SHA-256 duplicate
  Impact on KG: INGEST-01 extension of this pipeline must preserve the 202 Accepted contract; graph node creation is part of the async batch job, not the upload response

title: Document status state machine (as-built)
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/02-document-intelligence-rag.md
type: protocol
content:
  States: PENDING, PROCESSING, INDEXED, FAILED, ARCHIVED
  Transitions: ->[PENDING] on upload/folder detection; PENDING->[PROCESSING] on batch start; PROCESSING->[INDEXED] on success; PROCESSING->[FAILED] on error; INDEXED->[ARCHIVED] on user action; FAILED->[PENDING] on user retry
  Impact on KG: INGEST-01 must create the KnowledgeEntity when DocumentStatus transitions to INDEXED (not PENDING); a FAILED document must not produce a graph node

title: Folder scanning schedule (as-built default)
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/02-document-intelligence-rag.md
type: nfr
content:
  cron: "0 */15 * * * *" (every 15 minutes, Spring Batch scheduling)
  Filesystem watcher: disabled by default (WatchService available but off)
  Impact on KG: INGEST-01 graph node creation runs after the document is INDEXED; the 15-minute scan cycle is the effective minimum latency for new documents to appear in the graph

title: Supported document formats — CONFLICT FLAGGED
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/02-document-intelligence-rag.md AND documentazione/11-roadmap/01-fasi-sviluppo.md
type: schema
content:
  Per 02-document-intelligence-rag.md: PDF, DOCX, TXT, EML (4 formats via Apache Tika 2.9.2)
  Per 01-fasi-sviluppo.md: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT, MD, CSV, JSON, HTML (9 formats)
  CONFLICT: see INGEST-CONFLICTS.md [WARNING] "Supported document formats"
  Impact on KG: INGEST-01 "existing document ingestion also creates a graph node" must handle all actually-supported formats; the correct list must be confirmed before Phase 3 implementation

## Constraints: AI Agents

title: Agent temperature and token limits (as-built)
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/03-ai-agents.md
type: schema
content:
  TECH agent: temperature 0.2, maxTokens 4096
  BUSINESS agent: temperature 0.5, maxTokens 4096
  LEGAL agent: temperature 0.1, maxTokens 4096
  PERSONAL agent: temperature 0.7, maxTokens 2048
  Impact on KG: GraphRAG chat (Phase 7) will use the LLM Gateway directly, not the Agent endpoint; these per-agent parameters do not apply to GraphRAG queries unless GraphRAG is routed through an agent type

title: Agent execution interface contract (as-built)
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/03-ai-agents.md
type: api-contract
content:
  POST /api/v1/agents/execute with body { agentId, query }
  Response: AgentExecutionResult { response, citations, toolCalls, latencyMs, provider, model, tokenUsage }
  Citations: { documentId, filename, chunkIndex, text, similarityScore }
  Impact on KG: GraphRAG responses (RAG-02) include sourceNodeIds + traversedEdges — different citation model; do not reuse AgentExecutionResult for GraphRAG answers

## Constraints: n8n Automation

title: n8n webhook integration (as-built)
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/04-automazioni-n8n.md
type: protocol
content:
  Protocol: HTTP POST (webhook), Basic Auth
  n8n default URL: http://localhost:5678
  Webhook retry: max 3 attempts, backoff 2000ms
  Webhook timeout: 30s
  Registered event types: NEW_FILE, DOCUMENT_INDEXED, DOCUMENT_FAILED, SCHEDULED, CHAT_COMPLETED, AGENT_EXECUTED
  Impact on KG: Phase 5 / Phase 9 — graph events (GRAPH_NODE_CREATED, GRAPH_RELATION_ADDED, GRAPH_WEIGHT_UPDATED, etc.) are NOT yet defined as AutomationEvent enum values; Enterprise vertical (ENT-04 gap detection) may need new event types

## Constraints: Dashboard / Monitoring

title: Health check response schema (as-built)
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/06-dashboard-monitoraggio.md
type: api-contract
content:
  GET /api/v1/dashboard/health
  Response: { status, timestamp, services: { mysql, qdrant, ollama, n8n }, metrics: { totalTokens, totalCostUsd, totalRequests, averageLatencyMs }, documents: { total, indexed, pending, processing, failed, archived }, batchJobs: { completed, failed, running, lastExecution } }
  Services polled: MySQL (30s, 5s timeout), Qdrant (30s, 5s timeout), Ollama (30s, 10s timeout), n8n (60s, 5s timeout)
  Service states: UP, DOWN, DEGRADED
  Impact on KG: Phase 6/7 frontend may need graph-specific metrics in the health response (graph node count, reconciliation job status); this requires extending the health endpoint response schema

title: Spring Boot Actuator endpoints (as-built)
source: documentazione/03-analisi-funzionale/06-dashboard-monitoraggio.md
type: api-contract
content:
  Exposed: /actuator/health, /actuator/info, /actuator/metrics, /actuator/metrics/{name}
  Planned (not yet active): /actuator/prometheus
  Impact on KG: Prometheus export is planned but not implemented; do not depend on it in Phase 1-5 observability

## PRD-derived domain constraints (from 25 ambiti-estensione PRDs)

### Universal KG constraints (asserted by ALL 25 PRDs — consistent with locked decisions)

title: Persistence model (universal)
source: 15-ambiti-estensione/20-motore-knowledge-graph-it.md (+ all 24 sibling PRDs)
type: schema
content:
  Structure: MySQL 8.0 graph_node / graph_edge tables (UUID CHAR(36)), recursive CTE traversal
  Semantics: Qdrant embeddings (separate collection per the localmind_graph_nodes boundary)
  Explicitly NO Neo4j / no dedicated graph DB this cycle (matches PROJECT.md Out-of-Scope + REQUIREMENTS.md)
  Migrations: Flyway, one query per file (CLAUDE.md rule)
  Impact: every vertical phase reuses the same physical store; no new datastore dependency is permitted

title: Weighted-edge model (universal)
source: 15-ambiti-estensione/20-motore-knowledge-graph-it.md, 21-graphrag-ai-it.md
type: schema
content:
  Edge weight in [0,1], derived by a per-domain WeightPolicy from factors:
    usage frequency, relevance/co-occurrence, dependency strength, user feedback,
    extraction confidence, recency/time decay (+ domain-specific: distance decay,
    semantic similarity, source authority/reliability, community consensus, freshness,
    anti-popularity hidden-gem boost for tourism).
  Weights are batch-recalculated, explainable, and (in education/compliance/ticketing) immutable/versioned.
  Impact: Phase 1 weight column + factors; Phase 5 async reinforcement; per-vertical WeightPolicy variants

title: AI / GraphRAG model (universal)
source: 15-ambiti-estensione/21-graphrag-ai-it.md (+ all verticals)
type: protocol
content:
  Hybrid GraphRAG = Qdrant semantic seed + MySQL weighted structural traversal (1+ hop).
  Ollama is the default local LLM; cloud optional and gated by privacy.
  Answers cite nodes + traversed edges (+ weights/chunk); anti-hallucination "non so" threshold.
  Endpoints converge on /api/v1/knowledge/graph/{ask,expand,path,subgraph}.
  Impact: verticals reuse the core GraphRAG service; they do not each build a separate RAG engine

title: Extensibility model (universal)
source: multiple (PF4J references in 20-24 + verticals)
type: protocol
content:
  Domain modules and connectors ship as PF4J plugins via the marketplace.
  Hexagonal architecture: pure domain wired in DomainConfig; adapters are @Component.
  Type registry replaces hard-coded enums; NodeTypeRegistry validates writes (422 on unknown type).
  Impact: each vertical is an installable domain module declaring its node/relation vocabulary

### Visualization technical constraints (VIZX) — Phase 6 enrichment

title: Graph visualizer rendering stack
source: 15-ambiti-estensione/22-visualizzazione-grafo-it.md
type: nfr
content:
  WebGL render engine (Sigma.js + graphology) with Canvas fallback; force-directed layout
  (ForceAtlas2) in a Web Worker; LoD/clustering controller; Angular Signals store.
  Server pagination budget with truncation metadata; controlled degradation; basic accessibility.
  NOTE: existing ROADMAP Phase 6 names Cytoscape.js. Library divergence — see INGEST-CONFLICTS.md [INFO].
  Candidate libs: Sigma.js+graphology (MVP), Cosmograph (extreme scale), G6, Cytoscape.js.
  Impact: roadmapper/planner must pick the rendering library for Phase 6 (Cytoscape.js vs Sigma.js).

### Security technical constraints (SEC) — Phases 1/2/5 enrichment

title: ReBAC authorization + pre-retrieval filter
source: 15-ambiti-estensione/25-sicurezza-privacy-it.md
type: protocol
content:
  ReBAC node/edge authorization, deny-by-default access decision engine, pre-retrieval filter on
  BOTH MySQL and Qdrant, exfiltration/AI-routing policy (Ollama-default), context minimization,
  tamper-evident audit (hash-chain), at-rest/in-transit encryption, secret management.
  Impact: hardens PRIV-01/02/03 and GRAG-03 permission gate; deny-by-default is stricter than current filter
</content>
